_comment: Policy of ws-mcp-filter (ADR-027), the filter in the stdio path of every local MCP server. Tools are named as the server names them (no mcp__server__ prefix); patterns are shell globs. Effective rules for a tab: defaults < server < levels.<WS_LEVEL> (levels.default when the tab's level has no entry) < profiles.<WS_PROFILE>; every allow list that applies must match and every deny list adds up, so a level or a profile only narrows. memory: true makes the server honour the tab's WS_MEMORY (off hides every tool; wing:W forces the wing on wingTools and hides the rest). writeTools is a regex on the tool name; for those, blockPrivate refuses <private> content and provenance stamps the named fields (prefix keeps the model's value after ' | ', set replaces it) when the tool's input schema has them. pinTools: block (a changed tool definition is withheld until 'ws-mcp-tools approve NAME') | warn | off. Yours to edit in a plain shell or from Menu > Settings; Claude cannot (guard.sh).
